title: ChatGPT-4 Turbo and Meta's LLaMA 3.1: A Relative Analysis of Answering Radiology Text-Based Questions

live_model.evidence: Abstract: 'GPT-4 Turbo performed at an overall accuracy of 88.6% (70/79 questions), outperforming LLaMA 3.1's 77.2% (61/79)'; 'OpenAI's GPT-4 Turbo (San Francisco, CA)...utilize deep learning'

prompt.location: Figure 2 (sequence-of-methodology figure shows one example question and GPT-4 Turbo's response, Part B)
prompt.note: One worked example is shown in a figure; the full set of 79 pediatric radiology questions is not confirmed to be listed verbatim in text/appendix.

claim.metric: overall accuracy (%) on pediatric radiology text-based questions
claim.location: Abstract and Results (70/79 correct); per-subsection breakdown also given (e.g., chest/cardiac best, vascular 66.7% worst)

data.source: Author-authored pediatric radiology text-based questions; not confirmed as a released public question bank

notes: Judged/scored by the authors (correct vs. incorrect against presumed reference answers) rather than an automated metric; only one Q&A pair is shown as a worked example, so exact question wording for the other 78 items is not confirmed available.
